answer: Yes, the notification specifies several dates and deadlines. The 31st day of July, 2026 is notified as the deadline to file an appeal or application before the Appellate Tribunal if the relevant order was communicated before the 1st day of May, 2026 or passed before the 1st day of February, 2026 [C4]. For orders communicated on or after 1st May, 2026, appeals may be filed within three months of communication, while applications for orders passed on or after 1st February, 2026 may be filed within six months of the order being passed [C4]. Additionally, the notification is deemed to come into force with effect from the 30th day of June, 2026 [C4].
